final_answer:
**Apple's gross margin for fiscal year 2024 (the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024) was $180,683 million** [DOC-1: "Fiscal year ended September 28, 2024: Total net sales: $391,035; Cost of sales: $210,352; Gross margin: $180,683"].

Supporting detail:
- This reconciles as total net sales of $391,035 million less cost of sales of $210,352 million [DOC-1], implying a gross margin percentage of approximately 46.2%.
- For context, the prior-year comparative in the same filing shows gross margin of $169,148 million on net sales of $383,285 million for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023 [DOC-1], an increase of $11,535 million (roughly 6.8%) year over year.

Comparability note: FY2024 was a 52-week year ended September 28, 2024, while FY2023 ended September 30, 2023; both figures are drawn from the same FY2024 10-K on a consistent consolidated basis, so the FY2024 figure itself is stated directly and requires no adjustment. Any period-over-period comparison should account for the differing fiscal period end dates.

ANSWER: $180,683 million
